versions.name: Camp Minsi
versions.address: 106 Camp Minsi Rd Pocono Summit, Pennsylvania 18346

features.note: Belaying, climbing, and rappelling on 60-foot natural cliffs above Tobyhanna Creek.
An off-site treetop ropes course with tightropes, rope nets, and swinging logs.
Quad-racing zip lines on the treetop adventure course.
A guided trail ride at an off-site ranch.
A 25-mile trail ride through the Lehigh Gorge.
Rifles, shotguns, and revolvers on interactive targets at the camp ranges.
Afternoon specialty adventures for Scouts thirteen and older.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/502-2026CampMinsiSummer); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored website points at the council golf outing rather than the camp, so the camp's own site was used instead; it names program areas only in summary form, hence the coarse codes.
